I often come across comments suggesting that the prospects for commercializing $SIVE are unclear.

We understand that the question is when a $1.2B order backlog will translate into quarterly revenue exceeding $5M.

This is why there are concerns that all these metrics might turn out to be an illusion.

However, my take is that we are in the lull before parabolic growth.

Last major $SIVE disclosure was 100M CW DFB laser capacity Q4 2027. And a new foundry partner (that makes 2 including Win Semi).

Expected $JBL revenue coming in H1 2027 (with lasers for Jabil's 1.6T LRO scaling up H2 2027).

There's channel checks along the way like CIOE where Sivers was engaged with Chinese pluggable makers + laser ASPs being raised.

70mW/100mW ranges were the most tight to Chinese pluggable makers, which was surprising.

Biggest industry read through was $LITE selling out into 2029, making agreements for 2030, and having hyperscalers pay for capacity expansion for 2031.

Last time I've seen "It's all over" type posts was... 3 months ago during the situational awareness liquidation. 

And... 3 months ago before that... with Iran tensions + Oil + Helium + LNG fears/pricing. 

And... few months ago before that. I'm sure everyone remembers Deepseek back in like 2025

Each one had genuine risks, with rate hikes/margin liquidations to oil prices + supply disruption. And now financing/credit markets. 

Not trying to downplay the risks but haven't seen it materialize in the companies I'm tracking (eg. optical sector) given counterparty types + sector visibility + arch

I can't give advice on what others should do but from what I'm seeing from $AAOI revenue ramp, it looks something like this from disclosed capacity. 

-> $858M Q1 2027
-> $1.29B Q2 2027
-> $1.62B Q3 2027
-> $1.89B Q4 2027
-> $2.14B Q1 2028

They're sitting on $6.8B MC right now. I'd be very impressed if they do $7.5B exit annualized revenue run rate in 2027 off 40% gross margins and markets assigned them the same valuation. 

And judging from $LITE making capacity agreements into 2030-2031... I don't quite think demand stalls out after 2027-2028.  

Anyway, lot of execution risk obviously, but
